title: Microsoft Entra federation trust configuration changed
description: Detects successful Microsoft Entra audit operations that change domain federation settings or domain authentication configuration.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary or unauthorized administrator may modify a federation trust to redirect or subvert authentication.
hypothesis.rationale: Microsoft explicitly recommends alerting on federation configuration changes, and MITRE documents domain trust modification as a persistence and privilege path; approved federation maintenance can produce the same operations.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify successful Set federation settings on domain and Set domain authentication operations while leaving failed changes and unrelated domain administration unmatched.

triage.summary: Identify the affected domain and initiator, validate the change against federation administration records and inspect sign-in behavior after the modification.
steps: Review the initiating user or application, source IP, target domain, modified properties, correlation identifier and surrounding audit operations.
Confirm the exact change with the approved identity or federation maintenance record and the expected administrator.
Inspect federation certificates, issuer endpoints, authentication type and subsequent privileged sign-ins; restore trusted configuration and contain the initiator if unauthorized.
false_positives: Approved federation migration, certificate rotation, domain conversion and identity-platform maintenance

validation.expected_outcome: Match successful federation settings or domain authentication changes; do not match failures, domain verification or unrelated domain administration.
